method: Four independent changes, 0/100/1000 rest free walls plus one fixed free target; 7 trials, 84 full geometry comparisons. Prior scene warm; changed immutable scene cache miss. Mutation/snapshot creation and equality classification outside timing. Complete world faces/normals per wall determine unchanged output, not a safe cache key. Both base scenes built before timing. totalMs is old full rebuild, controlMs is new bounded reuse. Alternating control/probe, shared lower caches and JIT/GC/system noise remain; differences are observed instrumentation/order effect, not exact correction. CPU only, no browser/frame/GPU/native.
